        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"初始化管理器：统一管理项目所有模块的初始化状态\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self):\n        \"\"\"初始化管理器\"\"\"\n        self.modules: Dict[str, ModuleStatus] = {}\n        self.check_functions: Dict[str, Callable[[], bool]] = {}\n        self.init_functions: Dict[str, Callable[[], Any]] = {}  # 初始化函数字典\n        self.instances: Dict[str, Any] = {}  # 存储初始化后的实例\n        self.init_time = datetime.now()\n        logger.info(\"初始化管理器已创建\")\n    \n    def register_module(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        category: str,\n        check_func: Optional[Callable[[], bool]] = None,\n        init_func: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None,\n        dependencies: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n        is_required: bool = True,\n        description: Optional[str] = None\n    ) -\u003e None:\n        \"\"\"注册需要初始化的模块\n        \n        Args:\n            name: 模块名称\n            category: 模块分类（foundation/core/optional）\n            check_func: 检查函数，返回True表示初始化成功\n            init_func: 初始化函数，返回初始化后的实例（可选）\n            dependencies: 依赖的其他模块名称列表\n            is_required: 是否为必需模块\n            description: 模块描述\n        \"\"\"\n        if name in self.modules:\n            logger.warning(f\"模块 {name} 已注册，将覆盖之前的注册\")\n        \n        self.modules[name] = ModuleStatus(\n            name=name,\n            category=category,\n            dependencies=dependencies or [],\n            is_required=is_required,\n            description=description\n        )\n        \n        if check_func:\n            self.check_functions[name] = check_func\n        \n        if init_func:\n            self.init_functions[name] = init_func\n        \n        logger.debug(f\"注册模块: {name} (分类: {category}, 必需: {is_required})\")\n    \n    def check_initialization(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n        ",

        "contents": "def register_all_modules(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e None:\n\n    \n    # 5. Chroma 向量数据库（延迟加载：启动时不连接，首次使用时再连接）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"chroma\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_chroma(),\n        dependencies=[\"config\", \"logger\"],\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"Chroma向量数据库连接 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 6. 索引管理器（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"index_manager\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_index_manager(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_index_manager(manager),\n        dependencies=[],  # 移除强制依赖，改为延迟初始化\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"索引管理器 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 7. RAG 服务（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"rag_service\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_rag_service(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_rag_service(manager),\n        dependencies=[\"llm_factory\"],  # 移除对 index_manager 的强制依赖\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"RAG服务 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 10. 对话管理器（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）",

        "contents": "class BackgroundPreloader:\n\n    \n    def _do_init(self) -\u003e None:\n        \"\"\"执行初始化（优化版：只初始化必需模块，延迟加载耗时组件）\"\"\"\n        try:\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.manager import InitializationManager\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry import register_all_modules\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.bootstrap import InitResult\n            \n            self._update_stage(\"创建初始化管理器\")\n            manager = InitializationManager()\n            register_all_modules(manager)\n            \n            # 只初始化必需模块（跳过 embedding、index_manager 等耗时模块）\n            for module_name in manager._topological_sort():\n                module = manager.modules[module_name]\n                display = module.description or module_name\n                \n                # 跳过非必需模块（延迟加载）\n                if not module.is_required:\n                    self._stage_details.append(f\"⏭️ {display} (延迟加载)\")\n                    continue\n                \n                self._update_stage(f\"初始化 {display}\")\n                success = manager.execute_init(module_name)\n                \n                if success:\n                    self._update_stage(f\"{display}\", module_name)\n                else:\n                    self._fail(f\"必需模块 {display} 初始化失败: {module.error}\")\n                    return\n            \n            # 创建轻量级服务（纯 LLM 模式，不依赖 index_manager）\n            self._update_stage(\"创建轻量级服务\")\n            rag_service, chat_manager = self._create_lightweight_services(manager)\n            \n            if not rag_service or not chat_manager:\n                self._fail(\"服务实例创建失败\")\n                return\n            \n            # 存储到 manager.instances 以便后续使用\n            manager.instances['rag_service'] = rag_service\n            manager.instances['chat_manager'] = chat_manager\n            \n            # 成功\n            summary = manager.get_status_summary()",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "@pytest.mark.fast\nclass TestRegistry:\n    \"\"\"Registry 模块测试\"\"\"\n    \n    def test_register_all_modules(self):\n        \"\"\"测试注册所有模块\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        register_all_modules(manager)\n        \n        # 验证至少注册了一些模块\n        assert len(manager.modules) \u003e 0\n    \n    def test_module_dependencies(self):\n        \"\"\"测试模块依赖关系\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        register_all_modules(manager)\n        \n        # 检查某些模块是否有依赖\n        for module_name, module_status in manager.modules.items():\n            if module_status.dependencies:\n                # 验证依赖的模块都已注册\n                for dep in module_status.dependencies:\n                    assert dep in manager.modules, f\"模块 {module_name} 的依赖 {dep} 未注册\"\n    \n    def test_required_vs_optional_modules(self):\n        \"\"\"测试必需和可选模块标记\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        register_all_modules(manager)\n        \n        # 验证至少有一些必需模块和一些可选模块\n        required_modules = [m for m in manager.modules.values() if m.is_required]\n        optional_modules = [m for m in manager.modules.values() if not m.is_required]\n        \n        assert len(required_modules) \u003e 0, \"应该有至少一个必需模块\"\n        # 可选模块可能为0，所以不强制检查",
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\ndef check_initialization(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n\n                return False\n        else:\n            # 没有检查函数，标记为跳过\n            module.status = InitStatus.SKIPPED\n            logger.debug(f\"⏭️  模块 {module_name} 跳过初始化检查（无检查函数）\")\n        \n        return module.status == InitStatus.SUCCESS\n    \n    def execute_init(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n        \"\"\"执行模块初始化\n        \n        Args:\n            module_name: 模块名称\n            \n        Returns:\n            bool: True表示初始化成功，False表示失败\n        \"\"\"\n        if module_name not in self.modules:\n            logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name} 未注册\")\n            return False\n        \n        module = self.modules[module_name]\n        \n        # 如果已经成功初始化，直接返回\n        if module.status == InitStatus.SUCCESS and module_name in self.instances:\n            logger.debug(f\"模块 {module_name} 已初始化，跳过\")\n            return True\n        \n        # 检查依赖\n        for dep in module.dependencies:\n            if dep not in self.modules:\n                logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name} 的依赖 {dep} 未注册\")\n                continue\n            \n            dep_status = self.modules[dep]\n            if dep_status.status != InitStatus.SUCCESS:\n                error_msg = f\"依赖模块 {dep} 未成功初始化\"\n                logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name}: {error_msg}\")\n                if module.is_required:\n                    module.status = InitStatus.FAILED\n                    module.error = error_msg\n                    return False\n                else:\n                    # 可选模块的依赖失败，标记为跳过\n                    module.status = InitStatus.SKIPPED\n                    module.error = error_msg\n                    return False\n        \n        # 执行初始化函数\n        if",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n初始化注册表：注册所有需要初始化的模块\n\n主要功能：\n- register_all_modules()：注册所有模块到初始化管理器\n- 定义各模块的检查函数和依赖关系\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom typing import Optional, Any\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.manager import InitializationManager, InitStatus\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.categories import InitCategory\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\nfrom backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry_checks import (\n    check_encoding, check_config, check_logger, check_embedding, check_chroma,\n    check_index_manager, check_llm_factory, check_query_engine, check_rag_service,\n    check_chat_manager, check_session_state, check_llama_debug, check_ragas\n)\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry_init import (\n    init_encoding, init_config, init_logger, init_embedding, init_index_manager,\n    init_llm_factory, init_session_state, init_rag_service, init_chat_manager\n)\n\nlogger = get_logger('initialization_registry')\n\n\ndef register_all_modules(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e None:\n    ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\n\n    \n    def execute_by_category(self, category: InitCategory) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"按分类执行初始化\n        \n        Args:\n            category: 分类枚举\n            \n        Returns:\n            Dict[str, bool]: 模块名称到初始化状态的映射\n        \"\"\"\n        results = {}\n        \n        # 获取该分类下的所有模块\n        category_modules = [\n            name for name, module in self.modules.items()\n            if module.category == category.value\n        ]\n        \n        # 按依赖顺序排序\n        sorted_modules = self._topological_sort()\n        category_modules = [m for m in sorted_modules if m in category_modules]\n        \n        logger.info(f\"开始初始化 {category.value} 分类的 {len(category_modules)} 个模块...\")\n        \n        for module_name in category_modules:\n            results[module_name] = self.execute_init(module_name)\n            \n            # 如果必需模块失败，停止初始化\n            module = self.modules[module_name]\n            if module.is_required and module.status == InitStatus.FAILED:\n                logger.error(f\"必需模块 {module_name} 初始化失败，停止 {category.value} 分类的初始化\")\n                break\n        \n        return results\n    \n    def execute_all(\n        self,\n        categories: Optional[List[InitCategory]] = None\n    ) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        ",

        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\n\n    \n    def execute_all(\n        self,\n        categories: Optional[List[InitCategory]] = None\n    ) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"执行所有或指定分类的初始化\n        \n        Args:\n            categories: 要初始化的分类列表，None表示所有分类\n            \n        Returns:\n            Dict[str, bool]: 模块名称到初始化状态的映射\n        \"\"\"\n        results = {}\n        \n        # 确定要初始化的分类\n        if categories is None:\n            categories = CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER\n        \n        logger.info(f\"开始执行初始化，分类顺序: {[c.value for c in categories]}\")\n        \n        # 按分类顺序执行\n        for category in categories:\n            category_results = self.execute_by_category(category)\n            results.update(category_results)\n            \n            # 检查是否有必需模块失败\n            failed_required = [\n                name for name, success in category_results.items()\n                if not success and self.modules[name].is_required\n            ]\n            \n            if failed_required:\n                logger.error(f\"分类 {category.value} 中有 {len(failed_required)} 个必需模块失败: {failed_required}\")\n                # 继续执行其他分类，但记录错误\n        \n        return results\n    \n    def check_all(self) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"检查所有模块的初始化状态\n        \n        Returns:\n            Dict[str, bool]: 模块名称到初始化状态的映射\n        \"\"\"\n        results = {}\n        \n        # 按依赖顺序排序（简单的拓扑排序）\n        sorted_modules = self._topological_sort()\n        \n        logger.info(f\"开始检查 {len(sorted_modules)} 个模块的初始化状态...\")\n        \n        for module_name in sorted_modules:\n            results[module_name] = self.check_initialization(module_name)\n        \n        return results\n    \n    def _topological_sort(self) -\u003e List[str]:\n        ",

        "contents": "def initialize_app(\n    categories: Optional[list[InitCategory]] = None,\n    show_progress: bool = False\n) -\u003e InitResult:\n    \"\"\"在应用启动时执行所有模块的初始化\n    \n    Args:\n        categories: 要初始化的分类列表，None表示所有分类\n        show_progress: 是否显示进度（Streamlit环境）\n        \n    Returns:\n        InitResult: 初始化结果，包含管理器实例和初始化状态\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"🚀 开始项目初始化...\")\n    \n    # 创建初始化管理器\n    manager = InitializationManager()\n    \n    # 注册所有模块\n    register_all_modules(manager)\n    \n    # 执行初始化（按分类顺序）\n    results = manager.execute_all(categories=categories)\n    \n    # 生成报告\n    report = manager.generate_report()\n    logger.info(\"\\n\" + report)\n    \n    # 获取状态摘要\n    summary = manager.get_status_summary()\n    \n    # 检查是否有必需的模块失败\n    failed_modules = summary['required_failed']\n    all_required_ready = len(failed_modules) == 0\n    \n    if failed_modules:\n        logger.error(f\"⚠️  有 {len(failed_modules)} 个必需模块初始化失败: {', '.join(failed_modules)}\")\n    else:\n        logger.info(\"✅ 所有必需模块初始化成功\")\n    \n    # 记录统计信息\n    logger.info(\n        f\"初始化统计: 总计={summary['total']}, \"\n        f\"成功={summary['success']}, \"\n        f\"失败={summary['failed']}, \"\n        f\"跳过={summary['skipped']}, \"\n        f\"待检查={summary['pending']}\"\n    )\n    \n    # 创建初始化结果\n    init_result = InitResult(\n        all_required_ready=all_required_ready,\n        manager=manager,\n        instances=manager.instances.copy(),\n        failed_modules=failed_modules,\n        summary=summary\n    )\n    \n    return init_result\n\n\ndef check_initialization_on_startup() -\u003e InitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"",

        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\ndef register_module(\n        self,\n        name: str,\n        category: str,\n        check_func: Optional[Callable[[], bool]] = None,\n        init_func: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None,\n        dependencies: Optional[List[str]] = None,\n        is_required: bool = True,\n        description: Optional[str] = None\n    ) -\u003e None:\n, 必需: {is_required})\")\n    \n    def check_initialization(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n        \"\"\"检查模块初始化状态\n        \n        Args:\n            module_name: 模块名称\n            \n        Returns:\n            bool: True表示初始化成功，False表示失败或未初始化\n        \"\"\"\n        if module_name not in self.modules:\n            logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name} 未注册\")\n            return False\n        \n        module = self.modules[module_name]\n        \n        # 检查依赖\n        for dep in module.dependencies:\n            if dep not in self.modules:\n                logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name} 的依赖 {dep} 未注册\")\n                continue\n            \n            dep_status = self.modules[dep]\n            if dep_status.status != InitStatus.SUCCESS:\n                logger.warning(f\"模块 {module_name} 的依赖 {dep} 未成功初始化\")\n                if module.is_required:\n                    module.status = InitStatus.FAILED\n                    module.error = f\"依赖模块 {dep} 未成功初始化\"\n                    return False\n        \n        # 执行检查函数\n        if",

        "contents": "@pytest.mark.fast\nclass TestInitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"InitializationManager 测试\"\"\"\n    \n    def test_manager_initialization(self):\n        \"\"\"测试管理器初始化\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        assert manager.modules == {}\n        assert manager.check_functions == {}\n        assert manager.init_functions == {}\n        assert manager.instances == {}\n    \n    def test_register_module(self):\n        \"\"\"测试模块注册\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        def check_func():\n            return True\n        \n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"test_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value,\n            check_func=check_func,\n            is_required=True\n        )\n        \n        assert \"test_module\" in manager.modules\n        assert \"test_module\" in manager.check_functions\n        assert manager.modules[\"test_module\"].name == \"test_module\"\n        assert manager.modules[\"test_module\"].category == InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value\n    \n    def test_register_module_with_dependencies(self):\n        \"\"\"测试带依赖的模块注册\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        # 先注册依赖模块\n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"dep_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value,\n            check_func=lambda: True\n        )\n        \n        # 注册依赖 dep_module 的模块\n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"test_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n            check_func=lambda: True,\n            dependencies=[\"dep_module\"]\n        )\n        \n        assert \"test_module\" in manager.modules\n        assert \"dep_module\" in manager.modules[\"test_module\"].dependencies\n    \n    def test_check_initialization_success(self):\n        \"\"\"测试检查初始化成功\"\"\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n初始化分类系统：定义模块分类和初始化顺序\n\n主要功能：\n- InitCategory：初始化分类枚举（基础/核心/可选）\n- 分类显示名称映射\n- 分类初始化顺序定义\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom typing import Dict, List\n\n\nclass InitCategory(Enum):\n    \"\"\"初始化分类枚举\"\"\"\n    FOUNDATION = \"foundation\"  # 基础层：编码、配置、日志等基础设施\n    CORE = \"core\"              # 核心层：Embedding、Chroma、IndexManager、LLM、RAGService、ChatManager\n    OPTIONAL = \"optional\"       # 可选层：LlamaDebug、RAGAS等可观测性工具\n\n\n# 分类显示名称映射\nCATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES: Dict[str, str] =",

            "text": "主要功能："
          },

            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- InitCategory：初始化分类枚举（基础/核心/可选）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- 分类显示名称映射"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- 分类初始化顺序定义"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "from enum import Enum"

            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13
          },

            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "class InitCategory(Enum):"
          },

            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "    \"\"\"初始化分类枚举\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "    FOUNDATION = \"foundation\"  # 基础层：编码、配置、日志等基础设施"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "    CORE = \"core\"              # 核心层：Embedding、Chroma、IndexManager、LLM、RAGService、ChatManager"

          {

            "lineNumber": 18,

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\ndef execute_init(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n\n        \n        # 执行初始化函数\n        if module_name in self.init_functions:\n            start_time = datetime.now()\n            try:\n                init_func = self.init_functions[module_name]\n                instance = init_func()\n                elapsed = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()\n                \n                # 存储实例\n                if instance is not None:\n                    self.instances[module_name] = instance\n                \n                module.status = InitStatus.SUCCESS\n                module.init_time = elapsed\n                logger.info(f\"✅ 模块 {module_name} 初始化成功 (耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s)\")\n                return True\n            except Exception as e:\n                elapsed = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()\n                module.status = InitStatus.FAILED\n                module.error = str(e)\n                module.error_traceback = traceback.format_exc()\n                module.init_time = elapsed\n                logger.error(f\"❌ 模块 {module_name} 初始化失败: {e}\", exc_info=True)\n                return False\n        else:\n            # 没有初始化函数，尝试使用检查函数\n            if module_name in self.check_functions:\n                return self.check_initialization(module_name)\n            else:\n                # 既没有初始化函数也没有检查函数，标记为跳过\n                module.status = InitStatus.SKIPPED\n                logger.debug(f\"⏭️  模块 {module_name} 跳过初始化（无初始化函数）\")\n                return False\n    \n    def execute_by_category(self, category: InitCategory) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        ",

        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\ndef check_initialization(self, module_name: str) -\u003e bool:\n\n                    return False\n        \n        # 执行检查函数\n        if module_name in self.check_functions:\n            start_time = datetime.now()\n            try:\n                result = self.check_functions[module_name]()\n                elapsed = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()\n                \n                if result:\n                    module.status = InitStatus.SUCCESS\n                    module.init_time = elapsed\n                    logger.info(f\"✅ 模块 {module_name} 初始化成功 (耗时: {elapsed:.2f}s)\")\n                else:\n                    # 检查函数返回 False（通常是可选模块未启用）\n                    module.status = InitStatus.FAILED\n                    error_msg = \"检查函数返回False\"\n                    # 为特定模块提供更详细的错误信息\n                    if module_name == \"llama_debug\":\n                        if hasattr(config, 'ENABLE_DEBUG_HANDLER') and not config.ENABLE_DEBUG_HANDLER:\n                            error_msg = \"LlamaDebug 未启用（ENABLE_DEBUG_HANDLER=False），请在 application.yml 中设置 observability.llama_debug.enable=true\"\n                        else:\n                            error_msg = \"LlamaDebug 模块检查失败，请检查日志获取详细信息\"\n                    module.error = error_msg\n                    module.init_time = elapsed\n                    logger.warning(f\"⚠️  模块 {module_name} 检查未通过: {error_msg}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                elapsed = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()\n                module.status = InitStatus.FAILED\n                module.error = str(e)\n                module.error_traceback = traceback.format_exc()\n                module.init_time = elapsed\n                logger.error(f\"❌ 模块 {module_name} 初始化失败: {e}\", exc_info=True)\n                return False\n        else:\n            # 没有检查函数，标记为跳过",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def check_initialization_on_startup() -\u003e InitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"在应用启动时检查所有模块的初始化状态（向后兼容）\n    \n    Returns:\n        InitializationManager: 初始化管理器实例\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"🚀 开始项目初始化检查...\")\n    \n    # 创建初始化管理器\n    manager = InitializationManager()\n    \n    # 注册所有模块\n    register_all_modules(manager)\n    \n    # 检查所有模块\n    results = manager.check_all()\n    \n    # 生成报告\n    report = manager.generate_report()\n    logger.info(\"\\n\" + report)\n    \n    # 获取状态摘要\n    summary = manager.get_status_summary()\n    \n    # 检查是否有必需的模块失败\n    if summary['required_failed']:\n        logger.error(f\"⚠️  有 {len(summary['required_failed'])} 个必需模块初始化失败: {', '.join(summary['required_failed'])}\")\n    else:\n        logger.info(\"✅ 所有必需模块初始化成功\")\n    \n    # 记录统计信息\n    logger.info(\n        f\"初始化统计: 总计={summary['total']}, \"\n        f\"成功={summary['success']}, \"\n        f\"失败={summary['failed']}, \"\n        f\"跳过={summary['skipped']}, \"\n        f\"待检查={summary['pending']}\"\n    )\n    \n    return manager",

        "contents": "@pytest.mark.fast\nclass TestInitializationManager:\n\n    \n    def test_check_initialization_success(self):\n        \"\"\"测试检查初始化成功\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"test_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value,\n            check_func=lambda: True\n        )\n        \n        result = manager.check_initialization(\"test_module\")\n        \n        assert result is True\n        assert manager.modules[\"test_module\"].status == InitStatus.SUCCESS\n    \n    def test_check_initialization_failed(self):\n        \"\"\"测试检查初始化失败\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"test_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value,\n            check_func=lambda: False\n        )\n        \n        result = manager.check_initialization(\"test_module\")\n        \n        assert result is False\n        assert manager.modules[\"test_module\"].status == InitStatus.FAILED\n    \n    def test_check_initialization_dependency_failed(self):\n        \"\"\"测试依赖失败的情况\"\"\"\n        manager = InitializationManager()\n        \n        # 注册依赖模块（失败）\n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"dep_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.FOUNDATION.value,\n            check_func=lambda: False,\n            is_required=True\n        )\n        \n        # 注册依赖 dep_module 的模块\n        manager.register_module(\n            name=\"test_module\",\n            category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n            check_func=lambda: True,\n            dependencies=[\"dep_module\"],\n            is_required=True\n        )\n        \n        # 先检查依赖模块\n        manager.check_initialization(\"dep_module\")\n        \n        # 检查 test_module（应该因为依赖失败而失败）\n        result = manager.check_initialization(\"test_module\")\n        \n        assert result is False\n        assert manager.modules[\"test_module\"].status == InitStatus.FAILED\n    \n    def test_execute_init_success(self):\n        \"\"\"测试执行初始化成功\"\"\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n初始化管理模块：统一管理项目所有模块的初始化状态和日志记录\n\n主要功能：\n- InitializationManager：初始化管理器，统一记录所有模块的初始化状态\n- initialize_app()：执行所有模块的初始化（推荐）\n- check_initialization_on_startup()：检查所有模块的初始化状态（向后兼容）\n- register_module()：注册需要初始化的模块\n- execute_init()：执行模块初始化\n- generate_report()：生成初始化报告\n\n执行流程：\n1. 注册所有需要初始化的模块\n2. 在应用启动时统一执行初始化（按分类顺序：基础 -\u003e 核心 -\u003e 可选）\n3. 记录每个模块的成功/失败/跳过状态\n4. 生成详细的初始化报告\n\n特性：\n- 集中管理所有模块初始化\n- 实际执行初始化（不仅是检查）\n- 分类系统（基础/核心/可选）\n- 依赖注入和实例存储\n- 详细的日志记录\n- 初始化状态统计\n- 失败原因追踪\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.manager import InitializationManager, InitStatus, ModuleStatus\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.bootstrap import (\n    initialize_app,\n    check_initialization_on_startup,\n    InitResult\n)\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.categories import (\n    InitCategory,\n    CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES,\n    CATEGORY_ICONS,\n    CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    'InitializationManager',\n    'InitStatus',\n    'ModuleStatus',\n    'initialize_app',\n    'check_initialization_on_startup',\n    'InitResult',\n    'InitCategory',\n    'CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES',\n    'CATEGORY_ICONS',\n    'CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER',\n]",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "初始化管理模块：统一管理项目所有模块的初始化状态和日志记录"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4,
            "text": "主要功能："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "- InitializationManager：初始化管理器，统一记录所有模块的初始化状态"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6,
            "text": "- initialize_app()：执行所有模块的初始化（推荐）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- check_initialization_on_startup()：检查所有模块的初始化状态（向后兼容）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "- register_module()：注册需要初始化的模块"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "- execute_init()：执行模块初始化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "- generate_report()：生成初始化报告"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "执行流程："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "1. 注册所有需要初始化的模块"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "2. 在应用启动时统一执行初始化（按分类顺序：基础 -\u003e 核心 -\u003e 可选）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "3. 记录每个模块的成功/失败/跳过状态"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "4. 生成详细的初始化报告"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "特性："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "- 集中管理所有模块初始化"
          },

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n初始化管理器：统一管理项目所有模块的初始化状态和日志记录\n\n主要功能：\n- InitializationManager：初始化管理器类\n- register_module()：注册需要初始化的模块\n- check_initialization()：检查模块初始化状态\n- generate_report()：生成初始化报告\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Callable, Any\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import datetime\nimport traceback\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.categories import (\n    InitCategory,\n    CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES,\n    CATEGORY_ICONS,\n    CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER\n)\n\nlogger = get_logger('initialization')\n\n\nclass InitStatus(Enum):\n    \"\"\"初始化状态枚举\"\"\"\n    PENDING = \"pending\"  # 待初始化\n    SUCCESS = \"success\"  # 初始化成功\n    FAILED = \"failed\"    # 初始化失败\n    SKIPPED = \"skipped\"  # 跳过初始化（可选模块）\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ModuleStatus:\n    \"\"\"模块初始化状态\"\"\"\n    name: str",

        "contents": "def init_chat_manager(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e Any:\n    \"\"\"初始化对话管理器（延迟加载）\"\"\"\n    from backend.business.chat import ChatManager\n    from backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry_init import init_index_manager\n    \n    index_manager = manager.instances.get('index_manager')\n    if index_manager is None:\n        logger.info(\"IndexManager 未初始化，自动初始化（延迟加载）\")\n        try:\n            index_manager = init_index_manager(manager)\n            manager.instances['index_manager'] = index_manager\n            if 'index_manager' in manager.modules:\n                manager.modules['index_manager'].status = InitStatus.SUCCESS\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"延迟加载 IndexManager 失败: {e}\")\n            raise ValueError(f\"IndexManager 实例初始化失败: {e}\") from e\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        if 'chat_manager' in st.session_state and st.session_state.chat_manager is not None:\n            logger.info(\"使用 session_state 中已有的 ChatManager\")\n            return st.session_state.chat_manager\n    \n    enable_debug = False\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'debug_mode_enabled' in st.session_state:\n        enable_debug = st.session_state.debug_mode_enabled\n    \n    use_agentic_rag = False\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'use_agentic_rag' in st.session_state:\n        use_agentic_rag = st.session_state.use_agentic_rag\n    \n    selected_model_id = None\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'selected_model' in st.session_state:\n        selected_model_id = st.session_state.selected_model\n    \n    chat_manager = ChatManager(\n        index_manager=index_manager,\n        enable_debug=enable_debug,\n        enable_markdown_formatting=True,\n        use_agentic_rag=use_agentic_rag,\n        model_id=selected_model_id,\n    )\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        st.session_state.chat_manager = chat_manager\n    \n    return chat_manager",

        "contents": "# 2026-01-22 【bugfix】应用初始化失败修复-完成总结\n\n## 1. 任务概述\n\n**任务类型**：bugfix  \n**创建日期**：2026-01-22  \n**完成日期**：2026-01-22  \n**优先级**：P0（阻塞应用启动）\n\n**问题描述**：\n应用启动时连续遇到3个初始化错误，导致无法正常启动：\n1. &#96;registry.py&#96; 第172行语法错误：&#96;manager.register_module()&#96; 调用不完整，括号未闭合\n2. &#96;registry.py&#96; 第181行属性错误：使用了不存在的私有属性 &#96;_modules&#96;\n3. &#96;ChatManager&#96; 初始化错误：在使用 &#96;model_id&#96; 时未设置 &#96;api_key&#96; 属性\n\n**关联模块**：\n- &#96;backend/infrastructure/initialization/registry.py&#96;\n- &#96;backend/business/chat/manager.py&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 2. 关键步骤\n\n### 2.1 错误1：RAGAS 模块注册不完整\n\n**现象**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n'(' was never closed (registry.py, line 172)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**定位**：\n- 文件第172行的 &#96;manager.register_module()&#96; 调用只有部分参数\n- 缺少必需的参数和闭合括号\n\n**修复**：\n补全 RAGAS 模块注册代码，添加：\n- &#96;category&#96;: &#96;InitCategory.OPTIONAL.value&#96;\n- &#96;check_func&#96;: &#96;lambda: check_ragas()&#96;\n- &#96;dependencies&#96;: &#96;[\"config\", \"logger\"]&#96;\n- &#96;is_required&#96;: &#96;False&#96;\n- &#96;description&#96;: &#96;\"RAGAS评估工具\"&#96;\n- 闭合括号\n\n### 2.2 错误2：属性名错误\n\n**现象**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nAttributeError: 'InitializationManager' object has no attribute '_modules'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**定位**：\n- 第181行使用了错误的私有属性名 &#96;_modules&#96;\n- &#96;InitializationManager&#96; 类实际使用公有属性 &#96;modules&#96;\n\n**修复**：\n将 &#96;manager._modules&#96; 改为 &#96;manager.modules&#96;\n\n### 2.3 错误3：ChatManager 缺少 api_key 属性\n\n**现象**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nAttributeError: 'ChatManager' object has no attribute 'api_key'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**根因分析**：\n- 在使用新的 &#96;model_id&#96; 参数时，代码没有设置 &#96;self.api_key&#96; 属性\n- 只有在向后兼容模式（使用 &#96;model&#96; 参数）时才设置了该属性\n- 后续创建查询引擎时需要 &#96;self.api_key&#96;，导致报错\n\n**修复方案**：\n1. 在所有分支之前统一设置：&#96;self.api_key = api_key or config.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY&#96;\n2. 移除向后兼容分支中的重复赋值\n\n---\n\n## 3. 实施说明",

        "contents": "class IndexManager:\n\n    \n    def get_index(self) -\u003e VectorStoreIndex:\n        \"\"\"获取现有索引，支持延迟初始化\"\"\"\n        if self._index is None:\n            try:\n                # 尝试从向量存储加载索引\n                llama_embed_model = self._get_llama_index_compatible_embedding()\n                self._index = VectorStoreIndex.from_vector_store(\n                    vector_store=self.vector_store,\n                    storage_context=self.storage_context,\n                    embed_model=llama_embed_model,\n                )\n                \n                # 检查 collection 是否为空\n                try:\n                    if hasattr(self, 'chroma_collection') and self.chroma_collection:\n                        count = self.chroma_collection.count()\n                        if count \u003e 0:\n                            logger.info(f\"✅ 从向量存储加载索引成功: {count}个向量\")\n                        else:\n                            logger.info(\"ℹ️  Collection为空，将在添加文档后创建索引\")\n                            self._collection_is_empty = True\n                    else:\n                        logger.info(\"✅ 从向量存储加载索引成功\")\n                except Exception:\n                    logger.info(\"✅ 从向量存储加载索引成功（无法验证向量数量）\")\n                    \n            except Exception:\n                logger.info(\"ℹ️  没有找到现有索引，将在添加文档后创建\")\n                # 创建一个空索引对象（向后兼容），但标记需要创建\n                llama_embed_model = self._get_llama_index_compatible_embedding()\n                self._index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(\n                    [],\n                    storage_context=self.storage_context,\n                    embed_model=llama_embed_model,\n                )\n                self._collection_is_empty = True\n        \n        return self._index\n    \n    def clear_index(self):\n        \"\"\"清空索引\"\"\"\n        clear_index(self)",

        "contents": "class IndexManager:\n    \"\"\"索引管理器\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        collection_name: Optional[str] = None,\n        persist_dir: Optional[Path] = None,\n        embedding_model: Optional[str] = None,\n        chunk_size: Optional[int] = None,\n        chunk_overlap: Optional[int] = None,\n        embed_model_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding] = None,\n        embedding_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding] = None,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"初始化索引管理器\"\"\"\n        # 使用配置或默认值\n        self.collection_name = collection_name or config.CHROMA_COLLECTION_NAME\n        self.embedding_model_name = embedding_model or config.EMBEDDING_MODEL\n        self.chunk_size = chunk_size or config.CHUNK_SIZE\n        self.chunk_overlap = chunk_overlap or config.CHUNK_OVERLAP\n        \n        # 注意：Chroma Cloud模式不需要本地目录，persist_dir参数保留用于向后兼容但不再使用\n        self.persist_dir = persist_dir\n        \n        # 保存统一的Embedding实例\n        self._embedding_instance = embedding_instance\n        \n        # 初始化核心组件\n        self.embed_model, self.chroma_client, self.chroma_collection = init_index_manager(\n            collection_name=self.collection_name,\n            persist_dir=self.persist_dir,\n            embedding_model_name=self.embedding_model_name,\n            chunk_size=self.chunk_size,\n            chunk_overlap=self.chunk_overlap,\n            embed_model_instance=embed_model_instance,\n            embedding_instance=embedding_instance\n        )\n        \n        # 一次性获取必要信息（最多2次查询：count + peek）",

        "contents": "def init_index_manager(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e Any:\n    \"\"\"初始化索引管理器（延迟加载）\"\"\"\n    from backend.infrastructure.indexer import IndexManager\n    from backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry_init import init_embedding\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        if 'index_manager' in st.session_state and st.session_state.index_manager is not None:\n            logger.info(\"使用 session_state 中已有的 IndexManager\")\n            return st.session_state.index_manager\n    \n    embedding = manager.instances.get('embedding')\n    if embedding is None:\n        logger.info(\"Embedding 未初始化，自动初始化（延迟加载）\")\n        try:\n            embedding = init_embedding(manager)\n            manager.instances['embedding'] = embedding\n            if 'embedding' in manager.modules:\n                manager.modules['embedding'].status = InitStatus.SUCCESS\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"延迟加载 Embedding 失败: {e}\")\n            raise ValueError(f\"Embedding 实例初始化失败: {e}\") from e\n    \n    collection_name = config.CHROMA_COLLECTION_NAME\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'collection_name' in st.session_state:\n        collection_name = st.session_state.collection_name\n    \n    index_manager = IndexManager(\n        collection_name=collection_name,\n        embedding_instance=embedding\n    )\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        st.session_state.index_manager = index_manager\n        st.session_state.index_manager_validated = True\n    \n    return index_manager\n\n\ndef init_llm_factory(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e Any:\n    \"\"\"初始化LLM工厂\"\"\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# 2025-12-06 【optimization】优化索引管理器初始化性能-完成总结\n\n## 1. 任务概述\n\n### 1.1 任务元信息\n- **任务类型**: optimization（性能优化）\n- **执行日期**: 2025-12-06\n- **任务目标**: 优化 &#96;IndexManager&#96; 初始化过程中的性能瓶颈，将查询次数从11次减少到1-2次\n- **涉及模块**: &#96;src/infrastructure/indexer/&#96;\n\n### 1.2 背景与动机\n- 用户反馈索引管理器初始化非常缓慢\n- 经过性能分析发现初始化过程中存在大量重复的数据库查询\n- 主要问题：\n  - &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 和 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96; 都在执行相似的数据库操作\n  - 两个函数都重复调用了 &#96;get_collection()&#96;、&#96;count()&#96; 和 &#96;peek()&#96;\n  - &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 在初始化时遍历所有collections并统计详细信息，这些信息在初始化时不需要\n- 优化目标：将查询次数从11次减少到1-2次（最佳情况0次）\n\n## 2. 关键步骤与决策\n\n### 2.1 性能分析阶段\n1. **问题识别**: 分析 &#96;IndexManager&#96; 初始化流程，发现重复查询问题\n2. **瓶颈定位**: 识别出 &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 和 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96; 中的冗余查询\n3. **量化分析**: 统计出如果有5个collections，至少需要11次网络请求\n\n### 2.2 优化方案设计\n1. **合并查询逻辑**: 在 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96; 中一次性获取 &#96;count()&#96; 和 &#96;peek()&#96;\n2. **参数传递优化**: 将查询结果传递给后续函数，避免重复查询\n3. **移除不必要操作**: 移除 &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 中的 &#96;list_collections()&#96; 和遍历逻辑\n4. **直接使用已有对象**: 两个函数直接使用 &#96;chroma_collection&#96;，而不是重新获取\n\n### 2.3 实施优化\n1. **修改 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96;**: 一次性获取必要信息并传递给后续函数\n2. **优化 &#96;print_database_info()&#96;**: 移除冗余查询，添加 &#96;detailed&#96; 参数\n3. **优化 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96;**: 直接使用已有对象，接受参数避免重复查询\n\n## 3. 实施方法\n\n### 3.1 修改 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96;",
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "- 用户反馈索引管理器初始化非常缓慢"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "- 经过性能分析发现初始化过程中存在大量重复的数据库查询"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "- 主要问题："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "  - &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 和 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96; 都在执行相似的数据库操作"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "  - 两个函数都重复调用了 &#96;get_collection()&#96;、&#96;count()&#96; 和 &#96;peek()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "  - &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 在初始化时遍历所有collections并统计详细信息，这些信息在初始化时不需要"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "- 优化目标：将查询次数从11次减少到1-2次（最佳情况0次）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "## 2. 关键步骤与决策"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "### 2.1 性能分析阶段"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "1. **问题识别**: 分析 &#96;IndexManager&#96; 初始化流程，发现重复查询问题"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "2. **瓶颈定位**: 识别出 &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 和 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96; 中的冗余查询"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "3. **量化分析**: 统计出如果有5个collections，至少需要11次网络请求"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "### 2.2 优化方案设计"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28,
            "text": "1. **合并查询逻辑**: 在 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96; 中一次性获取 &#96;count()&#96; 和 &#96;peek()&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "2. **参数传递优化**: 将查询结果传递给后续函数，避免重复查询"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30,
            "text": "3. **移除不必要操作**: 移除 &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 中的 &#96;list_collections()&#96; 和遍历逻辑"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "4. **直接使用已有对象**: 两个函数直接使用 &#96;chroma_collection&#96;，而不是重新获取"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "### 2.3 实施优化"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34,
            "text": "1. **修改 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96;**: 一次性获取必要信息并传递给后续函数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "2. **优化 &#96;print_database_info()&#96;**: 移除冗余查询，添加 &#96;detailed&#96; 参数"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "3. **优化 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96;**: 直接使用已有对象，接受参数避免重复查询"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "## 3. 实施方法"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "### 3.1 修改 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96;"
          }
        ],

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 40
          },

        "contents": "def register_all_modules(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e None:\n\n    \n    # 5. Chroma 向量数据库（延迟加载：启动时不连接，首次使用时再连接）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"chroma\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_chroma(),\n        dependencies=[\"config\", \"logger\"],\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"Chroma向量数据库连接 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 6. 索引管理器（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"index_manager\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_index_manager(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_index_manager(manager),\n        dependencies=[],  # 移除强制依赖，改为延迟初始化\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"索引管理器 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 7. LLM 工厂\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"llm_factory\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_llm_factory(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_llm_factory(manager),\n        dependencies=[\"config\", \"logger\"],\n        is_required=True,\n        description=\"LLM工厂（DeepSeek）\"\n    )\n    \n    # 8. 会话状态\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"session_state\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_session_state(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_session_state(manager),\n        dependencies=[\"config\"],\n        is_required=True,\n        description=\"Streamlit会话状态初始化\"\n    )\n    \n    # 9. RAG 服务（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"rag_service\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_rag_service(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_rag_service(manager),\n        dependencies=[\"llm_factory\"],  # 移除对 index_manager 的强制依赖\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"RAG服务 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # 10. 对话管理器（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）",

        "contents": ",\n)\n\nlogger = get_logger('indexer')\n\n\ndef init_index_manager(\n    collection_name: Optional[str],\n    persist_dir: Optional[Path],  # 保留参数用于向后兼容，Chroma Cloud模式不再使用\n    embedding_model_name: str,\n    chunk_size: int,\n    chunk_overlap: int,\n    embed_model_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding],\n    embedding_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding]\n):\n    \"\"\"初始化索引管理器的核心组件\n    \n    Returns:\n        tuple: (embed_model, chroma_client, chroma_collection)\n    \"\"\"\n    # 初始化embedding模型\n    if embedding_instance is not None:\n        instance_type = type(embedding_instance).__name__\n        logger.info(f\"✅ 使用提供的Embedding实例: {instance_type}\")\n        embed_model = embedding_instance\n    elif embed_model_instance is not None:\n        logger.info(f\"✅ 使用预加载的Embedding模型: {embedding_model_name}\")\n        embed_model = embed_model_instance\n    else:\n        # 检查全局缓存\n        cached_embedding = get_embedding_instance()\n        if cached_embedding is not None:\n            cached_model_name = cached_embedding.get_model_name()\n            if cached_model_name == embedding_model_name:\n                logger.info(f\"✅ 使用全局缓存的Embedding模型: {embedding_model_name}\")\n                embed_model = cached_embedding\n            else:\n                logger.info(f\"🔄 模型配置变更: {cached_model_name} -\u003e {embedding_model_name}\")\n                embed_model = None\n        else:\n            embed_model = None\n        \n        if embed_model is None:\n            logger.info(f\"📦 创建Embedding模型: {embedding_model_name}\")\n            try:\n                embed_model = create_embedding(\n                    model_name=embedding_model_name,\n                    force_reload=False\n                )\n            except Exception as e:\n                logger.error(f\"❌ 创建Embedding模型失败: {e}\")\n                raise\n    \n    # 配置全局Settings\n    try:\n        Settings.embed_model = embed_model",

        "contents": "\"\"\"\n索引初始化模块：初始化索引管理器的核心组件\n\n使用 ChromaClientManager 全局单例复用连接，减少握手延迟。\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Optional\nimport logging\n\n# 在导入 chromadb 之前抑制底层HTTP库的详细日志（避免噪音）\n# 注意：chromadb 本身的日志保留，以便显示连接状态等有用信息\n_http_loggers = [\n    'urllib3', 'urllib3.connectionpool', 'urllib3.util',\n    'httpx', 'httpcore', 'httpcore.http11', 'httpcore.connection',\n    'httpcore.http2', 'httpcore.sync', 'httpcore.async',\n]\nfor logger_name in _http_loggers:\n    _logger = logging.getLogger(logger_name)\n    _logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)\n    _logger.propagate = False\n\n# 抑制遥测相关的日志（对用户无用的信息）\n_telemetry_loggers = [\n    'posthog', 'posthog.client',\n    'chromadb.telemetry',\n]\nfor logger_name in _telemetry_loggers:\n    _logger = logging.getLogger(logger_name)\n    _logger.setLevel(logging.WARNING)\n    _logger.propagate = False\n\n# 注意：chromadb、chromadb.api、chromadb.client 等保留默认日志级别\n# 这样可以看到连接成功、集合创建等有用的 INFO 级别日志\n\nfrom llama_index.core import Settings\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\nfrom backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\nfrom backend.infrastructure.embeddings.base import BaseEmbedding\nfrom backend.infrastructure.embeddings.factory import create_embedding, get_embedding_instance\nfrom backend.infrastructure.indexer.core.chroma_client import (\n    ChromaClientManager,\n    get_chroma_client,\n    get_chroma_collection,\n)\n\nlogger = get_logger('indexer')\n\n\ndef init_index_manager(\n    collection_name: Optional[str],\n    persist_dir: Optional[Path],  # 保留参数用于向后兼容，Chroma Cloud模式不再使用\n    embedding_model_name: str,\n    chunk_size: int,\n    chunk_overlap: int,\n    embed_model_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding],\n    embedding_instance: Optional[BaseEmbedding]\n):\n    ",

        "contents": "class BackgroundPreloader:\n\n    \n    def _do_init(self) -\u003e None:\n        \"\"\"执行初始化（优化版：只初始化必需模块，延迟加载耗时组件）\"\"\"\n        try:\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.manager import InitializationManager\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry import register_all_modules\n            from backend.infrastructure.initialization.bootstrap import InitResult\n            \n            self._update_stage(\"创建初始化管理器\")\n            manager = InitializationManager()\n            register_all_modules(manager)\n            \n            # 只初始化必需模块（跳过 embedding、index_manager 等耗时模块）\n            for module_name in manager._topological_sort():\n                module = manager.modules[module_name]\n                display = module.description or module_name\n                \n                # 跳过非必需模块（延迟加载）\n                if not module.is_required:\n                    self._stage_details.append(f\"⏭️ {display} (延迟加载)\")\n                    continue\n                \n                self._update_stage(f\"初始化 {display}\")\n                success = manager.execute_init(module_name)\n                \n                if success:\n                    self._update_stage(f\"{display}\", module_name)\n                else:\n                    self._fail(f\"必需模块 {display} 初始化失败: {module.error}\")\n                    return\n            \n            # 创建轻量级服务（纯 LLM 模式，不依赖 index_manager）\n            self._update_stage(\"创建轻量级服务\")\n            rag_service, chat_manager = self._create_lightweight_services(manager)\n            \n            if not rag_service or not chat_manager:\n                self._fail(\"服务实例创建失败\")\n                return\n            \n            # 存储到 manager.instances 以便后续使用\n            manager.instances['rag_service'] = rag_service\n            manager.instances['chat_manager'] = chat_manager\n            \n            # 成功\n            summary = manager.get_status_summary()",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "└─→ [2.3] 存储到向量数据库\n      └─ IndexManager [backend/infrastructure/indexer/index_manager.py]\n          ├─ 初始化向量存储：\n          │   ├─ 使用 Chroma Cloud 作为向量存储后端\n          │   ├─ Collection 名称：可自定义（默认 default）\n          │   └─ 连接到云端数据库\n          ├─ 创建或加载索引：\n          │   ├─ 新索引：VectorStoreIndex.from_documents()\n          │   └─ 增量添加：index.insert_ref_docs() 或 index.insert_nodes()\n          ├─ 存储向量：\n          │   ├─ 向量数据：每个节点的 embedding 向量\n          │   ├─ 元数据：节点元数据（文件路径、来源等）\n          │   └─ 文本内容：原始文本（用于展示和引用）\n          ├─ 构建向量 ID 映射：\n          │   └─ 记录文件路径到向量 ID 的映射（用于增量更新和删除）\n          └─ 更新缓存状态（如果启用）：\n              ├─ 标记向量化步骤完成\n              └─ 记录向量数量、文档 hash 等信息\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 6.3 查询阶段\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n[阶段3] 查询阶段（使用索引）\n│\n├─→ [3.1] 接收用户查询\n│     └─ RAGService.query() [backend/business/rag_api/rag_service.py]\n│         └─ Web界面：app.py → frontend/main.py → RAGService\n│\n├─→ [3.2] 查询引擎初始化与策略选择\n│     └─ ModularQueryEngine [backend/business/rag_engine/query/engine.py]\n│         │\n│         ├─ 固定策略模式（默认）：\n│         │   ├─ 策略验证：检查策略是否在 SUPPORTED_STRATEGIES 中\n│         │   ├─ 创建检索器：通过 create_retriever() 工厂方法创建\n│         │   ├─ 创建查询引擎：使用检索器创建 RetrieverQueryEngine\n│         │   └─ 记录日志：记录初始化的策略配置\n│         │\n│         └─ 自动路由模式（可选）：\n│             ├─ 延迟创建：不在初始化时创建检索器\n│             ├─ 创建路由器：初始化 QueryRouter 实例",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def initialize_app(\n    categories: Optional[list[InitCategory]] = None,\n    show_progress: bool = False\n) -\u003e InitResult:\n    \"\"\"在应用启动时执行所有模块的初始化\n    \n    Args:\n        categories: 要初始化的分类列表，None表示所有分类\n        show_progress: 是否显示进度（Streamlit环境）\n        \n    Returns:\n        InitResult: 初始化结果，包含管理器实例和初始化状态\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"🚀 开始项目初始化...\")\n    \n    # 创建初始化管理器\n    manager = InitializationManager()\n    \n    # 注册所有模块\n    register_all_modules(manager)\n    \n    # 执行初始化（按分类顺序）\n    results = manager.execute_all(categories=categories)\n    \n    # 生成报告\n    report = manager.generate_report()\n    logger.info(\"\\n\" + report)\n    \n    # 获取状态摘要\n    summary = manager.get_status_summary()\n    \n    # 检查是否有必需的模块失败\n    failed_modules = summary['required_failed']\n    all_required_ready = len(failed_modules) == 0\n    \n    if failed_modules:\n        logger.error(f\"⚠️  有 {len(failed_modules)} 个必需模块初始化失败: {', '.join(failed_modules)}\")\n    else:\n        logger.info(\"✅ 所有必需模块初始化成功\")\n    \n    # 记录统计信息\n    logger.info(\n        f\"初始化统计: 总计={summary['total']}, \"\n        f\"成功={summary['success']}, \"\n        f\"失败={summary['failed']}, \"\n        f\"跳过={summary['skipped']}, \"\n        f\"待检查={summary['pending']}\"\n    )\n    \n    # 创建初始化结果\n    init_result = InitResult(\n        all_required_ready=all_required_ready,\n        manager=manager,\n        instances=manager.instances.copy(),\n        failed_modules=failed_modules,\n        summary=summary\n    )\n    \n    return init_result\n\n\ndef check_initialization_on_startup() -\u003e InitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "logger = get_logger('indexer_service')\n\n\nclass IndexService:\n    \"\"\"索引服务 - 统一入口\n    \n    封装所有索引管理功能，提供统一的接口、错误处理和进度反馈。\n    类似 DataImportService 的设计模式。\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        collection_name: Optional[str] = None,\n        show_progress: bool = True,\n        embedding_model: Optional[str] = None,\n        chunk_size: Optional[int] = None,\n        chunk_overlap: Optional[int] = None,\n    ):\n        \"\"\"初始化索引服务\n        \n        Args:\n            collection_name: 集合名称\n            show_progress: 是否显示进度\n            embedding_model: Embedding模型名称\n            chunk_size: 文档分块大小\n            chunk_overlap: 文档分块重叠大小\n        \"\"\"\n        self.show_progress = show_progress\n        self._manager: Optional[IndexManager] = None\n        self._collection_name = collection_name\n        self._embedding_model = embedding_model\n        self._chunk_size = chunk_size\n        self._chunk_overlap = chunk_overlap\n    \n    @property\n    def manager(self) -\u003e IndexManager:\n        \"\"\"获取索引管理器实例（延迟初始化）\"\"\"\n        if self._manager is None:\n            self._manager = IndexManager(\n                collection_name=self._collection_name,\n                embedding_model=self._embedding_model,\n                chunk_size=self._chunk_size,\n                chunk_overlap=self._chunk_overlap,\n            )\n        return self._manager\n    \n    def build_index(\n        self,\n        documents: List[LlamaDocument],\n        show_progress: Optional[bool] = None,\n        github_sync_manager=None,\n        progress_callback: Optional[Callable[[int, int], None]] = None\n    ) -\u003e Tuple[VectorStoreIndex, Dict[str, List[str]]]:\n        ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "class InitializationManager:\n\n    \n    def execute_all(\n        self,\n        categories: Optional[List[InitCategory]] = None\n    ) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"执行所有或指定分类的初始化\n        \n        Args:\n            categories: 要初始化的分类列表，None表示所有分类\n            \n        Returns:\n            Dict[str, bool]: 模块名称到初始化状态的映射\n        \"\"\"\n        results = {}\n        \n        # 确定要初始化的分类\n        if categories is None:\n            categories = CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER\n        \n        logger.info(f\"开始执行初始化，分类顺序: {[c.value for c in categories]}\")\n        \n        # 按分类顺序执行\n        for category in categories:\n            category_results = self.execute_by_category(category)\n            results.update(category_results)\n            \n            # 检查是否有必需模块失败\n            failed_required = [\n                name for name, success in category_results.items()\n                if not success and self.modules[name].is_required\n            ]\n            \n            if failed_required:\n                logger.error(f\"分类 {category.value} 中有 {len(failed_required)} 个必需模块失败: {failed_required}\")\n                # 继续执行其他分类，但记录错误\n        \n        return results\n    \n    def check_all(self) -\u003e Dict[str, bool]:\n        \"\"\"检查所有模块的初始化状态\n        \n        Returns:\n            Dict[str, bool]: 模块名称到初始化状态的映射\n        \"\"\"\n        results = {}\n        \n        # 按依赖顺序排序（简单的拓扑排序）\n        sorted_modules = self._topological_sort()\n        \n        logger.info(f\"开始检查 {len(sorted_modules)} 个模块的初始化状态...\")\n        \n        for module_name in sorted_modules:\n            results[module_name] = self.check_initialization(module_name)\n        \n        return results\n    \n    def _topological_sort(self) -\u003e List[str]:\n        ",

        "contents": "def init_chat_manager(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e Any:\n    \"\"\"初始化对话管理器（延迟加载）\"\"\"\n    from backend.business.chat import ChatManager\n    from backend.infrastructure.initialization.registry_init import init_index_manager\n    \n    index_manager = manager.instances.get('index_manager')\n    if index_manager is None:\n        logger.info(\"IndexManager 未初始化，自动初始化（延迟加载）\")\n        try:\n            index_manager = init_index_manager(manager)\n            manager.instances['index_manager'] = index_manager\n            if 'index_manager' in manager.modules:\n                manager.modules['index_manager'].status = InitStatus.SUCCESS\n        except Exception as e:\n            logger.error(f\"延迟加载 IndexManager 失败: {e}\")\n            raise ValueError(f\"IndexManager 实例初始化失败: {e}\") from e\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        if 'chat_manager' in st.session_state and st.session_state.chat_manager is not None:\n            logger.info(\"使用 session_state 中已有的 ChatManager\")\n            return st.session_state.chat_manager\n    \n    enable_debug = False\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'debug_mode_enabled' in st.session_state:\n        enable_debug = st.session_state.debug_mode_enabled\n    \n    use_agentic_rag = False\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'use_agentic_rag' in st.session_state:\n        use_agentic_rag = st.session_state.use_agentic_rag\n    \n    selected_model_id = None\n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state') and 'selected_model' in st.session_state:\n        selected_model_id = st.session_state.selected_model\n    \n    chat_manager = ChatManager(\n        index_manager=index_manager,\n        enable_debug=enable_debug,\n        enable_markdown_formatting=True,\n        use_agentic_rag=use_agentic_rag,\n        model_id=selected_model_id,\n    )\n    \n    if hasattr(st, 'session_state'):\n        st.session_state.chat_manager = chat_manager\n    \n    return chat_manager",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n状态管理工具模块\n初始化和管理Streamlit会话状态\n\n主要功能：\n- init_session_state()：初始化Streamlit会话状态，包括索引管理、对话管理等\n- initialize_sources_map()：初始化来源映射\n- save_message_to_history()：保存消息到历史\n- invalidate_service_cache()：使服务缓存失效\n- rebuild_services()：重建 RAGService 和 ChatManager（配置变更时调用）\n\n特性：\n- 完整的会话状态初始化\n- 单例模式管理服务\n- 配置变更时的服务重建\n\"\"\"\n\nimport streamlit as st\nfrom typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional\nfrom frontend.utils.sources import convert_sources_to_dict\nfrom backend.infrastructure.config import config\n\n\ndef init_session_state() -\u003e None:\n    \"\"\"初始化会话状态\"\"\"\n    # 设置默认collection_name（使用配置中的默认值）\n    if 'collection_name' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.collection_name = config.CHROMA_COLLECTION_NAME\n    \n    # 索引和对话管理\n    if 'index_manager' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.index_manager = None\n    \n    if 'chat_manager' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.chat_manager = None\n    \n    if 'messages' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.messages = []\n    \n    if 'index_built' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.index_built = False\n    \n    if 'hybrid_query_engine' not in st.session_state:\n        st.session_state.hybrid_query_engine = None\n    \n    # GitHub 增量更新相关\n    if 'github_sync_manager' not in st.session_state:\n        from backend.infrastructure.data_loader.github_sync import GitHubSyncManager\n        st.session_state.github_sync_manager = GitHubSyncManager(config.GITHUB_SYNC_STATE_PATH)\n    \n    if 'github_repos' not in st.session_state:\n        # 从同步状态中加载已存在的仓库列表\n        st.session_state.github_repos = st.session_state.github_sync_manager.list_repositories()\n    \n    # 调试模式与可观测性（默认开启）\n    if",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "\"\"\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "状态管理工具模块"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 3,
            "text": "初始化和管理Streamlit会话状态"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5,
            "text": "主要功能："
          },

        "contents": "\"\"\"\n索引构建模块 (Indexer Package)：提供向量索引的构建、管理和维护功能\n\n核心功能：从文档构建向量索引，提供搜索、更新、统计等管理功能。\n\n快速开始：\n    \u003e\u003e\u003e from backend.infrastructure.indexer import IndexService\n    \u003e\u003e\u003e service = IndexService(collection_name=\"my_collection\")\n    \u003e\u003e\u003e index, vector_ids = service.build_index(documents)\n    \u003e\u003e\u003e results = service.search(\"查询文本\")\n\n主要接口：\n- IndexService: 统一索引服务（推荐）\n  - build_index(): 构建或更新索引\n  - search(): 搜索相似文档\n  - get_stats(): 获取统计信息\n  - incremental_update(): 增量更新\n- IndexManager: 底层索引管理器（高级用法）\n- 便捷函数: create_index_from_directory()\n\n模块结构：\n- service.py: 服务层，统一索引接口和流程编排\n- core/: 核心层（IndexManager、初始化）\n- build/: 构建层（构建入口、正常模式、文档过滤）\n- utils/: 工具层（统计、清理、更新、ID管理、文档操作等）\n\n设计说明：\n本包采用服务层统一接口，类似 data_loader 的设计模式。\n将索引管理的不同职责按层级拆分，提高代码可维护性。\n\"\"\"\n\n# 统一服务类（推荐使用）\nfrom backend.infrastructure.indexer.service import IndexService\n\n# 底层组件（高级用法）\nfrom backend.infrastructure.indexer.core.manager import IndexManager\n\n# 便捷函数\nfrom backend.infrastructure.indexer.utils.convenience import create_index_from_directory\n\n# Embedding状态查询（向后兼容）\ndef get_embedding_model_status() -\u003e dict:\n    \"\"\"",

        "contents": "def register_all_modules(manager: InitializationManager) -\u003e None:\n\n    )\n    \n    # 10. 对话管理器（延迟加载：启动时不初始化，首次使用时再初始化）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"chat_manager\",\n        category=InitCategory.CORE.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_chat_manager(),\n        init_func=lambda: init_chat_manager(manager),\n        dependencies=[\"llm_factory\"],  # 移除对 index_manager 的强制依赖\n        is_required=False,  # 改为可选，延迟加载\n        description=\"对话管理器 - 延迟加载\"\n    )\n    \n    # ========== 可选层 ==========\n    \n    # 11. 查询引擎（可选）\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"query_engine\",\n        category=InitCategory.OPTIONAL.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_query_engine(),\n        dependencies=[\"index_manager\", \"llm_factory\"],\n        is_required=False,\n        description=\"模块化查询引擎\"\n    )\n    \n    # 12. LlamaDebug 观察器\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"llama_debug\",\n        category=InitCategory.OPTIONAL.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_llama_debug(),\n        dependencies=[\"config\", \"logger\"],\n        is_required=False,\n        description=\"LlamaDebug调试工具\"\n    )\n    \n    # 13. RAGAS 评估器\n    manager.register_module(\n        name=\"ragas\",\n        category=InitCategory.OPTIONAL.value,\n        check_func=lambda: check_ragas(),\n        dependencies=[\"config\", \"logger\"],\n        is_required=False,\n        description=\"RAGAS评估工具\"\n    )\n    \n    logger.info(f\"所有模块注册完成，共注册 {len(manager.modules)} 个模块\")",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "def check_initialization_on_startup() -\u003e InitializationManager:\n    \"\"\"在应用启动时检查所有模块的初始化状态（向后兼容）\n    \n    Returns:\n        InitializationManager: 初始化管理器实例\n    \"\"\"\n    logger.info(\"🚀 开始项目初始化检查...\")\n    \n    # 创建初始化管理器\n    manager = InitializationManager()\n    \n    # 注册所有模块\n    register_all_modules(manager)\n    \n    # 检查所有模块\n    results = manager.check_all()\n    \n    # 生成报告\n    report = manager.generate_report()\n    logger.info(\"\\n\" + report)\n    \n    # 获取状态摘要\n    summary = manager.get_status_summary()\n    \n    # 检查是否有必需的模块失败\n    if summary['required_failed']:\n        logger.error(f\"⚠️  有 {len(summary['required_failed'])} 个必需模块初始化失败: {', '.join(summary['required_failed'])}\")\n    else:\n        logger.info(\"✅ 所有必需模块初始化成功\")\n    \n    # 记录统计信息\n    logger.info(\n        f\"初始化统计: 总计={summary['total']}, \"\n        f\"成功={summary['success']}, \"\n        f\"失败={summary['failed']}, \"\n        f\"跳过={summary['skipped']}, \"\n        f\"待检查={summary['pending']}\"\n    )\n    \n    return manager",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "3. **优化 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96;**: 直接使用已有对象，接受参数避免重复查询\n\n## 3. 实施方法\n\n### 3.1 修改 &#96;IndexManager.__init__()&#96;\n**文件**: &#96;src/infrastructure/indexer/core/manager.py&#96;\n\n**关键改动**:\n- 在调用 &#96;print_database_info()&#96; 和 &#96;ensure_collection_dimension_match()&#96; 之前，一次性获取 &#96;count()&#96; 和 &#96;peek()&#96;\n- 将查询结果作为参数传递给两个函数，避免重复查询\n- 添加异常处理，确保即使查询失败也能继续初始化\n\n**代码示例**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\n# 一次性获取必要信息（最多2次查询：count + peek）\ntry:\n    collection_count = self.chroma_collection.count()\n    sample_data = self.chroma_collection.peek(limit=1) if collection_count \u003e 0 else None\nexcept Exception as e:\n    logger.warning(f\"获取collection信息时出错: {e}，将使用默认值\")\n    collection_count = 0\n    sample_data = None\n\n# 打印基本信息（使用已有数据，不额外查询）\nprint_database_info(\n    self,\n    collection_count=collection_count,\n    sample_data=sample_data,\n    detailed=False\n)\n\n# 检测维度（使用已有数据，不额外查询）\nensure_collection_dimension_match(\n    self,\n    collection_count=collection_count,\n    sample_data=sample_data\n)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3.2 优化 &#96;print_database_info()&#96;\n**文件**: &#96;src/infrastructure/indexer/utils/info.py&#96;\n\n**关键改动**:\n- 移除 &#96;list_collections()&#96; 和遍历所有collections的逻辑（初始化时不需要）\n- 直接使用 &#96;index_manager.chroma_collection&#96;，而不是重新 &#96;get_collection()&#96;\n- 添加 &#96;collection_count&#96; 和 &#96;sample_data&#96; 参数，避免重复查询\n- 添加 &#96;detailed&#96; 参数，初始化时只打印基本信息（&#96;detailed=False&#96;）\n- 详细信息（文件类型、仓库列表等）仅在 &#96;detailed=True&#96; 时获取\n\n**函数签名变更**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;python\ndef print_database_info(\n    index_manager: \"IndexManager\",\n    collection_count: Optional[int] = None,",

        "contents": "\"\"\"\n便捷函数模块：提供从目录创建索引的便捷函数\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Optional, TYPE_CHECKING\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.logger import get_logger\n\nif TYPE_CHECKING:\n    from backend.infrastructure.indexer.core.manager import IndexManager\n\nlogger = get_logger('indexer')\n\n\ndef create_index_from_directory(\n    directory_path: str | Path,\n    collection_name: Optional[str] = None,\n    recursive: bool = True\n) -\u003e \"IndexManager\":\n    \"\"\"从目录创建索引（便捷函数）\n    \n    Args:\n        directory_path: 文档目录路径\n        collection_name: 集合名称\n        recursive: 是否递归加载\n        \n    Returns:\n        IndexManager对象\n    \"\"\"\n    # 延迟导入以避免循环导入\n    from backend.infrastructure.indexer.core.manager import IndexManager\n    from backend.infrastructure.data_loader import DataImportService\n    \n    # 使用统一服务加载文档\n    logger.info(f\"📂 从目录加载文档: {directory_path}\")\n    service = DataImportService(show_progress=False)\n    result = service.import_from_directory(directory_path, recursive=recursive)\n    \n    if not result.success or not result.documents:\n        logger.warning(\"⚠️  未找到任何文档\")\n        if result.errors:\n            logger.error(f\"错误: {result.errors}\")\n        return IndexManager(collection_name=collection_name)\n    \n    documents = result.documents\n    \n    # 创建索引管理器\n    index_manager = IndexManager(collection_name=collection_name)\n    \n    # 构建索引\n    index_manager.build_index(documents)\n    \n    return index_manager",

        "contents": "\"\"\"\n索引构建模块单元测试\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom llama_index.core import Document\nfrom backend.infrastructure.indexer import IndexManager\n\n\n@pytest.mark.fast\nclass TestIndexManager:\n    \"\"\"索引管理器测试\"\"\"\n    \n    @pytest.fixture\n    def temp_index_manager(self, temp_vector_store):\n        \"\"\"创建临时索引管理器\"\"\"\n        return IndexManager(\n            collection_name=\"test_collection\",\n            persist_dir=temp_vector_store,\n            chunk_size=256,\n            chunk_overlap=20\n        )\n    \n    def test_initialization(self, temp_index_manager):\n        \"\"\"测试初始化\"\"\"\n        assert temp_index_manager is not None\n        assert temp_index_manager.collection_name == \"test_collection\"\n        assert temp_index_manager.chunk_size == 256\n        assert temp_index_manager.chunk_overlap == 20\n    \n    def test_build_index_with_documents(self, temp_index_manager, sample_documents):\n        \"\"\"测试使用文档构建索引\"\"\"\n        index = temp_index_manager.build_index(sample_documents, show_progress=False)\n        \n        assert index is not None\n        \n        # 验证索引统计\n        stats = temp_index_manager.get_stats()\n        assert stats['document_count'] \u003e 0\n        assert stats['collection_name'] == 'test_collection'\n    \n    def test_build_index_empty_documents(self, temp_index_manager):\n        \"\"\"测试使用空文档列表\"\"\"\n        index = temp_index_manager.build_index([], show_progress=False)\n        \n        assert index is not None  # 应该返回索引对象\n    \n    def test_get_index(self, temp_index_manager, sample_documents):\n        \"\"\"测试获取索引\"\"\"\n        # 先构建索引\n        temp_index_manager.build_index(sample_documents, show_progress=False)\n        \n        # 获取索引\n        index = temp_index_manager.get_index()\n        assert index is not None\n    \n    def test_get_index_before_build(self, temp_index_manager):\n        ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"\"\"\n初始化管理模块：统一管理项目所有模块的初始化状态和日志记录\n\n主要功能：\n- InitializationManager：初始化管理器，统一记录所有模块的初始化状态\n- initialize_app()：执行所有模块的初始化（推荐）\n- check_initialization_on_startup()：检查所有模块的初始化状态（向后兼容）\n- register_module()：注册需要初始化的模块\n- execute_init()：执行模块初始化\n- generate_report()：生成初始化报告\n\n执行流程：\n1. 注册所有需要初始化的模块\n2. 在应用启动时统一执行初始化（按分类顺序：基础 -\u003e 核心 -\u003e 可选）\n3. 记录每个模块的成功/失败/跳过状态\n4. 生成详细的初始化报告\n\n特性：\n- 集中管理所有模块初始化\n- 实际执行初始化（不仅是检查）\n- 分类系统（基础/核心/可选）\n- 依赖注入和实例存储\n- 详细的日志记录\n- 初始化状态统计\n- 失败原因追踪\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.manager import InitializationManager, InitStatus, ModuleStatus\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.bootstrap import (\n    initialize_app,\n    check_initialization_on_startup,\n    InitResult\n)\nfrom backend.infrastructure.initialization.categories import (\n    InitCategory,\n    CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES,\n    CATEGORY_ICONS,\n    CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER\n)\n\n__all__ = [\n    'InitializationManager',\n    'InitStatus',\n    'ModuleStatus',\n    'initialize_app',\n    'check_initialization_on_startup',\n    'InitResult',\n    'InitCategory',\n    'CATEGORY_DISPLAY_NAMES',\n    'CATEGORY_ICONS',\n    'CATEGORY_INIT_ORDER',\n]",
